outcome: Costs of childbirth (total spending, government reimbursement, out-of-pocket payments)
cohort: Rural patients in the New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS) undergoing childbirth in Yong'an county and two control counties in Fujian province, China.
finding: The implementation of the EBP policy was associated with a significant decrease in cesarean delivery rates and reduced total, government reimbursement, and out-of-pocket spending per admission, without increasing readmission rates.
mod_finding: The EBP reform was associated with a 33.97% decrease in the probability of cesarean delivery.
